snippet.title: The Sacrilege - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready to experience The Sacrilege, a visual and narrative adventure that combines the language of cinema with the interactivity of video games. Every scene, every shot, every piece of dialogue has been meticulously crafted to draw you into an intense, dark, and deeply immersive dramatic story.

The Sacrilege is a 2D movie-game with interactive minigames to advance the film.
